 """Derive deployment status."""
 
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+
+
+_CLASSIFICATION_BY_EVENT_STATUS = {
+    "completed": "ready",
+    "failed": "failed",
+    "failure": "failed",
+    "error": "failed",
+    "started": "pending",
+    "running": "pending",
+    "pending": "pending",
+    "queued": "pending",
+}
+_EVENT_STATUS_PRIORITY = {
+    "failed": 3,
+    "failure": 3,
+    "error": 3,
+    "completed": 2,
+    "started": 1,
+    "running": 1,
+    "pending": 1,
+    "queued": 1,
+}
+
+
+def _event_time(event: dict[str, str]) -> datetime:
+    """Return an event timestamp that can be compared chronologically."""
+    timestamp = event["at"]
+    if timestamp.endswith("Z"):
+        timestamp = f"{timestamp[:-1]}+00:00"
+    parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(timestamp)
+    if parsed.tzinfo is None:
+        parsed = parsed.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+    return parsed.astimezone(timezone.utc)
+
+
+def _event_order(event: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[datetime, int, str]:
+    status = event["status"]
+    return (_event_time(event), _EVENT_STATUS_PRIORITY.get(status, 0), status)
+
